concerns.text: FR-004 requires simulating retrieval ranking based on 'topological signatures (via graph similarity to query graphs)'. The tasks list (T022, T023) explicitly implements TF-IDF Cosine Similarity for ranking and extracts topology *only* from retrieved documents. There is no task to implement the graph-similarity ranking mechanism required by FR-004, leaving the functional requirement unimplemented.

FR-007 mandates enforcing a 'time limit for the entire pipeline execution' to ensure N * 60s <= 6h. Task T008 only addresses the *sample size* constraint (N ≤ 360) and truncation logic. There is no task to implement runtime monitoring, wall-clock enforcement, or a timeout mechanism to guarantee the 6-hour CI budget is not exceeded during execution.

SC-005 requires measuring the statistical significance (p-value) of a paired t-test against a predetermined alpha level. Task T029 focuses on logging the Recall@10 ratio and checking a 0.70 threshold. There is no task explicitly implementing the calculation of the p-value from the t-test and comparing it against an alpha level to validate the hypothesis.

SC-002 requires measuring the 'percentage reduction in metadata generation time' specifically. Task T030 asks to calculate 'wall-clock time and percentage reduction' generally. There is no task to isolate the 'metadata generation' phase (graph construction) from the total pipeline time to ensure the metric matches the success criterion.

SC-001 requires measuring correlation between 'average modularity of retrieved documents' and Recall@k. Task T032 asks to log a generic 'status field' and r-value. There is no task explicitly verifying that the correlation calculation is performed specifically on the *retrieved subset* of documents as defined in the success criterion, rather than the full corpus.
